reason: It costs me nothing to send one request, and getting several written prices side by side is exactly how I find the cheapest small system I can afford now. The photos of the labels matter too, because I'm paying from abroad and can't check the roof myself.
objection: I worry every company will quote a full big system I can't pay for, when what I need is a small starter setup my family can add to later. Then this is just another way of finding out solar is too expensive.
would_change_my_mind: If the replies came back with only big expensive systems and no small starter option that can be expanded, I wouldn't bother using it again.
